'''Club of a Thousand Bears''' is a gold weapon given to the player as part of a quest to kill a [[Rabid Bear]].  The quest requires the player to wield this weapon when the bear dies.

==Acquisition==
Given during the following quests:
* [[Bear Club for Women]] 
* [[Bear Club for Men]]

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage|Blunt Dmg]]: 15-15
:[[Inscription]]: None

==Dye==
This item cannot be [[dye]]d.

==Notes==
* Other weapons with this appearance:
**{{w}} [[Havok's Maul]] ([[Unique item|unique]])
**{{w}} [[Spiked Club]]
**{{w}} [[The Ugly Stick]] (unique)
* [[Wintergreen Hammer]] has identical stats.

==Trivia==
* This weapon may be a reference to the South Park episode [[w:Make Love, Not Warcraft|Make Love, Not Warcraft]]. In the episode, the characters were given the Sword of a Thousand Truths to defeat another player who was on a rampage within the game.
